assertions.summary: Fresh BYOK conversation de67dc8d rendered a natural-Chinese skill summary and the saved console showed listSkills merged 101 skills with no forbidden filesystem tool-call markers, but the renderer boot-path capture remained empty for slash_commands_updated. A reversible postcheck in the same conversation captured slash_commands_updated via the same renderer tap, so the boot-path event was absent rather than malformed or uncapturable.

commands.observation: Created fresh conversation de67dc8d and installed the renderer-side boot-path tap before sending the prompt.

commands.observation: Saved the final reply screenshot, body-text transcription, installed-skills snapshot, conversation URL, console log, empty boot-path ipc-events.json, and a tool-call marker scan showing no forbidden filesystem tool names in the saved console.

commands.command: python3 create ~/.factory/skills/__val_cross_001_postcheck_*__/SKILL.md; wait; move probe to /tmp/val-cross-001-rerun-trash/; re-read tap buffer
commands.observation: The same renderer tap captured droid-sdk and skills-watcher slash_commands_updated events during the reversible postcheck, proving the tap works and that the missing boot-path event was absent rather than uncapturable.
